description: Local Turbo adapter, offered as an optional Big Love softness/sharpness adjustment. Strength 0.3 is a suggested starting point, not a verified preset.

compatibility.notes: Qwen 2.1 target is inferred from the local filename and checkpoint notes; exact training provenance and inference compatibility have not been verified. Big Love notes describe an optional Turbo ratio from -0.3 to 0.5. This is an adjustment range for that checkpoint, not a general Turbo acceleration recipe. No checkpoint is marked verified; no step count or sigma schedule is applied automatically.
